name: Dame! tte Itta no ni... Madoka no Jijou!
original_name: ダメッ!っていったのに…まどかの事情!
source:
After class one day the protagonist asked little loli Madoka to let him watch her pee.
It was the start of a glorious shame relationship.

Piss, urination themes.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ109076.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一天放学后，主人公问名叫小圆的小姑娘，能不能让他看她小便。两人就这样开始了一段既美妙又羞耻的关系。

本作以小便、排尿为题材。
